items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Well, George Delcy used to run the managing plays.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, you used to play with me when I got my teeth fish. I didn't call a right man George Delcy.
Well, George Delcy used to run the managing plays.
It was George Delcy, it was George Delcy's place. It was old man Anthony's son-in-law. Oh, it was his place? And we opened it up. Me, Chris Bond, and Peter Burkage. Opened that place up.
